copy.headline: One hull. Four commercial layers. One service day.
copy.body: Committed campus plans put the schedule spine on the water. Spot seats, shared experiences, and private charters fill the same vessel across the rest of the day — so capex works harder than a commute-only boat.

layers.title: Open / spot seats
layers.body: Yield-managed seats on spare commute capacity and shoulder sailings.

layers.title: Shared experiences
